title: Salas rebuts the EMP explanation

tellings.quote: Bob Salas responded to this claim, quote unquote, it would have been irresponsible and unthinkable for the U.S. Air Force to jeopardize the operational status of these weapons.

related.note: Salas's rebuttal disputes the WSJ claim that an EMP test caused the 1967 Malmstrom shutdowns; it is a competing account of the same event.

plain: The 1967 shutdown of nuclear missiles at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana was explained in the Wall Street Journal as caused by an electromagnetic pulse, a burst of energy that can knock out electronics, but Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer who was there, rejects that. Michels quotes Salas's reply: "it would have been irresponsible and unthinkable for the U.S. Air Force to jeopardize the operational status of these weapons." If Salas is right, the shutdown still has no ordinary explanation.
